text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wow, they're all so cute~!
These are costumes used in past lives,
right?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
To gather this much information entirely
on your own...
Fufu, as expected of you, Tran-san.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, it's nothing at all. If we're
making a new live outfit,
we have to learn from the past first. For
instance—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
This one is... quite a vivid outfit, isn't
it?
It will stand out even from afar, and I
imagine it will look stunning on stage
during a concert.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, idol-style outfits are a classic
staple for lives, after all.
There are energetic ones like this, and as
for others...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"The dress is absolutely gorgeous too!
Conveying my gratitude to Trainer-san in
this outfit... I'd be so happy if it
pleases them."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, there were yukata outfits as well,
weren't there?
If we all dance together, it's bound to be
a lively and fun concert.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"All of these outfits are so lovely... Ah,
this obi sash!
It looks a little like the one on a yukata
I used to own."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That yukata was my favorite when I was
little.
I used to wear it a lot to summer
festivals with Big Bro... I mean,
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That yukata was my favorite when I was
little.
I used to wear it a lot to summer
festivals with Big Sis... I mean,
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~, as expected of childhood friends!
Thanks for the juicy info♪
...Ah, but come to think of it, I also...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
That dress from earlier really looked like
the princess from that RPG I used to
play~.
Hehe, remember beating it while on a call
with Trainer-chan?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. What wonderful memories both of you
have.
You share such an intimate bond with your
Trainer—Oh my.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Look at the time... Pardon me, I shall
take my leave for today.
I will continue to think of ideas for the
costume as well.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was a splendid match. I'm glad I
invited you, Pisa.
Your mathematical thinking really does
shine in strategy games.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
No, not quite as well as you, Ruler. But I
had a wonderful time.
Quietly enjoying a game like this brings
such peace to the heart.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Right? That's the beauty of board
games—you can focus solely on the battle
right in front of you.
You look tired from concert prep, too...
Play in moderation and give yourself a
break.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much.
Once the outfits are decided, I'll let
Ruler-san know as well.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm looking forward to it. Now, for
the next game...
Excuse me, it's from Trainer. ...Hm, this
is—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Wha... Seriously!? This one's out of
print and impossible to find anywhere...!
Ha-ha, that's my right-hand man for you!
Later, we're gonna..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"............ Did I surprise you? It seems
my Trainer acquired a new board game.
They asked me... to come play a match in
the Trainer's office tomorrow."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, very well, I shall train you
personally.
Trainer occasionally comes up with good
strategies as well. We should expect
nothing less this time.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that sounds exciting. Ruler-san's
Trainer
is quite knowledgeable about board games,
too... Oh my?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it... all of you share
such a close bond with your Trainers.
Buena-san, Tran-san, and the others too...
Ah—!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah... maybe with this...! Ehehe!
Um, Ruler-san, could you keep me company
for just a little bit?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Heya~ So you came up with some costume
ideas?
Pisa-chan and... huh, Ruler-chan?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Actually, I consulted Ruler-san, and
she shared something with me.
A very important way of thinking regarding
this live's outfit.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"............ Huh? Me? ...What are you
talking about?"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
This live performance is meant to express
our gratitude to all the Trainers.
In that case... instead of something
flashy, how about more approachable
outfits?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Just as you and the others are so close
with Trainer-san, Tran-san...
I feel gratitude is something conveyed
precisely because you're close."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
That is why, rather than a flashy, one-off
outfit, I thought something familiar and
durable...
something you can wear for a long time,
like everyday clothes, might be best.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wow... I think that's wonderful! Showing
our appreciation to our Trainer
doesn't just end with the live
performance, after all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ruler-san, thank you so much!
To come up with such a wonderful idea just
from Pisa-san's story...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'm down with that, too... Honestly, that
was a complete blind spot for me.
Casual-looking outfits, huh... What a
brilliant mind you have, Ruler-chan.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, there are a few other things I
wanted to ask your advice on. Could you
help me out?
Like costume designs and colors... I
really need your help, Ruler-chan!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
............—Heh.
Very well. I shall lead this board called
a live concert to victory.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Fufu.
Being together with everyone... it feels
like this will be a wonderfully
heartwarming time.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yes, extend all the way through your
fingertips.
The softer the dance, the more conscious
you must be of keeping your nerves
razor-sharp.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you very much! I'm starting to
get the hang of it.
Ruler-san, are you knowledgeable about
this kind of dance too?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Nothing much, I simply had many
opportunities to attend social gatherings.
Now then... Tran-san, could you record a
full run-through for us?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yup-yup!
...So anyway, the outfits are decided, and
rehearsals are going swimmingly~.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It suits everyone very well.
I wonder if Trainer will like it too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm sure they'll love it!
Let's see, since we've settled on the
dance and outfits, all that's left is...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's the live concert venue! Find the
place destiny leads you to!
It's the final prep for the 'Trainer
Appreciation Festival'! Let's fire it
up--!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!!
